visual.general_description: Aggregate study selection and propensity-matching flowchart.
visual.detailed_description: Black outlined boxes on white form a vertical cohort-selection flowchart. The top box reads 231 lesions in 225 patients who underwent ESD for prepyloric or pyloric lesions (Jan 2016–Dec 2021). A rightward arrow leads to an exclusion box listing 17 non-adenoma/non-early gastric cancer lesions and 6 duplicate smaller lesions. A downward arrow leads to 208 lesions in 208 patients. The connector branches to 173 C-ESD at left and 35 TA-ESD at right, then rejoins above a downward arrow into Propensity score matching. Below matching, connectors branch to 66 C-ESD and 33 TA-ESD. No physiological axes, patient names or panel letters are printed.

visual.general_description: Six panels show endoscopic dissection of a pyloric lesion and the pinned resected specimen.
visual.detailed_description: Panels A–C form the top row and D–F the bottom row in a three-column grid. A–E show endoscopic mucosa, blue-green stained tissue fields, flap manipulation and resection bed. F is a gross-specimen photograph with pins, orientation labels and partial ruler. All six capital panel letters are printed at upper-left. No plot or numeric clinical trend is present.
